Enum Class GainFoodEnum

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<GainFoodEnum>
it.polimi.ingsw.enumerations.GainFoodEnum
All Implemented Interfaces:
GainFoodModifier, Serializable, Comparable<GainFoodEnum>, Constable
public enum GainFoodEnum extends Enum<GainFoodEnum> implements GainFoodModifier
Represents the available food gain effects that can be applied to a player.

Each constant defines a specific food gain strategy by implementing GainFoodModifier.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • FOOD_FOR_SET

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_FOR_SET
      Grants food when the player completes a new set of all character types. Checks whether the played card increases the number of complete sets.

    • FOOD_FOR_CRAFTER

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_FOR_CRAFTER
      Grants food based on the number of identical crafters the player has collected. Food is awarded when the player reaches an even count of identical crafter cards, even the symbol.

    • FOOD_FOR_HUNTER_HUNT

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_FOR_HUNTER_HUNT
      Activates a food bonus for the hunters during a hunt event. This is a one-time effect to activate the player's passive effect.

    • FOOD_FOR_ARTIST_PAINT

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_FOR_ARTIST_PAINT
      Activates a food bonus for the painters during a paint event. This is a one-time effect to activate the player's passive effect.

    • FOOD_FLAT

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_FLAT
      Grants a flat amount of food to the player. This is a one-time effect.

    • FOOD_EXTRA

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_EXTRA
      Activates an extra food bonus on the player's queue. This is a one-time effect to activate the player's passive effect.

    • FOOD_FOR_HUNTER

      public static final GainFoodEnum FOOD_FOR_HUNTER
      Grants food equal to the number of hunter cards the player has.
